
Various binomial distributions are shown in the visualisation below, for different values of\ $\n$ and\ $p$.



```{r, BinomialDemo, echo=FALSE, fig.align="center", fig.cap="Poisson distributions."}
library(plotly)

###  Parameters  ###
ns <- c(10, 20)      # Number of trials
ps <- c(0.2, 0.5)    # Success probabilities
x_max <- max(ns)     # Maximum x (number of successes) to display

x <- 0:x_max

### Compute y-axis range for all combinations (to keep axis consistent)
max_y <- max(sapply(ns, function(n) sapply(ps, function(p) dbinom(x, size = n, prob = p))))
yrange <- c(0, max_y * 1.05)  # small padding

###  Create figure  ###
fig <- plot_ly(width = 700, 
               height = 450)

# Add all traces, first trace visible
trace_index <- 1
for(n in ns){
  for(p in ps){
    y <- dbinom(x, 
                size = n, 
                prob = p)  # PMF
    
    fig <- fig %>% add_trace(
      x = x,
      y = y,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = "darkgreen", 
                  width = 2, 
                  dash = "dash"),
      marker = list(size = 8),
      visible = ifelse(trace_index == 1, 
                       TRUE, 
                       FALSE),  # first trace visible
      name = paste0("n=", n, ", p=", p),
      showlegend = FALSE
    )
    
    trace_index <- trace_index + 1
  }
}

###  Build buttons  ###
buttons <- list()
trace_index <- 1

for(n in ns){
  for(p in ps){
    vis <- rep(FALSE, 
               length(ns) * length(ps))
    vis[trace_index] <- TRUE
    
    mean_val <- n * p
    var_val  <- n * p * (1 - p)
    
    buttons[[trace_index]] <- list(
      method = "update",
      args = list(
        list(visible = vis),
        list(
          title = paste0("Binomial PMF: n=", n, ", p=", p),
          yaxis = list(range = yrange),
          annotations = list(
            list(
              x = 0.95, 
              y = 0.95,
              xref = "paper", 
              yref = "paper",
              text = paste0("mean=", round(mean_val,2),
                            "<br>var=", round(var_val,2)),
              showarrow = FALSE,
              xanchor = "right", 
              yanchor = "top",
              font = list(size = 12, 
                          color = "black")
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      label = paste0("n=", n, ", p=", p)
    )
    
    trace_index <- trace_index + 1
  }
}

###  Arrange buttons in 2x2 grid  ###
top_row_buttons <- buttons[sapply(buttons, function(b) grepl("n=10", b$label))]
bottom_row_buttons <- buttons[sapply(buttons, function(b) grepl("n=20", b$label))]

# --- Layout ---
fig <- fig %>% layout(
  title = list(text = "Binomial Distribution PMF", x = 0.5),
  xaxis = list(title = "Number of successes", range = c(0, x_max)),
  yaxis = list(title = "PMF", range = yrange),
  updatemenus = list(
    list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.2,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = top_row_buttons
    ),
    list(
      type = "buttons",
      direction = "right",
      x = 0,
      y = -0.3,
      xanchor = "left",
      yanchor = "top",
      buttons = bottom_row_buttons
    )
  )
)

fig
```
